title: Safe Cove Yacht Bow-Rail Repair
description: The same yacht at Safe Cove on February 7, 2023. Before, at 7:13 a.m.: damaged and missing bow-rail sections. After, at 10:12 a.m.: the repaired bow rail is fitted around the forward deck. The deck hatch, windlass, anchor-locker cover and covered work bay match in both photos.
